- The last snapshot with the good data is most likely 100024 (append, 2026-11-02 12:00 UTC). Snapshot 100025 isn't in the history, so I can't tell what it was.

1. Roll back to **100024**, the last state before the change that set the amounts to zero. This is my recommendation.
2. Roll back to **100026**, the literal snapshot just before the bad commit. Only do this if you've confirmed it still holds the correct data.

Which one do you want? Rolling back is reversible: I can return the table to 100027 afterwards if needed.
